title: textured quads from tileset
shortDescription: Instanced quads with frames picked from a TileSet
description: Like *textured quads from texture atlas*, but the frames come from a `TileSet`: the texture catalog declares the tile size, and the tileset cuts the image into tiles of equal size, kept in an atlas of its own. Each quad gets `tileset.atlas.randomFrame()`. The material is a `MeshBasicNodeMaterial` with an `alphaTestNode` and `DoubleSide`, to which the shared helper `createTexturedQuads()` adds the position and color nodes.
